svg.aria-label: An 8-bit pixel-art scene on a white background: a marketer sits at a small desk in front of one big CRT terminal, under a wall sign that reads MARKETING AS CODE — AGENTS AT WORK. The loop runs two agent sessions back to back. First they type FIND KEYWORDS WE CAN RANK FOR; an SEO agent calls DataForSEO and checks SERP ranks, each with a progress bar filling, reports FOUND 12 GAPS with MARKETING AS CODE as the top one while the ranking chart on the wall climbs, updates the keyword tracking and creates three content tasks — the screen border flashes green with a checkmark and the marketer throws their arms up under falling confetti. The screen clears and they type PROCESS THE TEAM MEETING; a memory agent reads the transcript and files tasks into Asana, logs 6 decisions and 9 tasks, and confirms MEMORY UPDATED with a second green flash and celebration, before the terminal resets to a blinking cursor.
